title: Airbnb Occupancy Rate Scraper — input

locationQueries.title: Places
locationQueries.description: Places as typed on Airbnb, e.g. ["Lisbon, Portugal"], ["Alfama, Lisbon"], ["Brooklyn, NY"]. Every listing Airbnb returns for the place (up to maxListingsPerQuery) gets one occupancy row per month. A place Airbnb does not recognise is reported as an unknown_area status row and costs nothing: write it as Airbnb spells it, with the country when ambiguous. Use for "Airbnb occupancy rate in <city>" and market runs; for exact listings use listingIds.
locationQueries.sectionDescription: Search places and/or paste Airbnb URLs (search results pages, listing pages) and/or listing ids. At least one.

startUrls.title: Airbnb URLs
startUrls.description: Airbnb search URLs (https://www.airbnb.com/s/Porto--Portugal/homes?room_types[]=Entire home/apt&min_bedrooms=2) or listing URLs (https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/12345678). A search URL keeps its filters: room type, price band, bedrooms, amenities, map bounds. Use for "occupancy of the listings in this search". A URL from another site is rejected before anything is charged. Default empty.

listingIds.title: Listing ids
listingIds.description: Numeric Airbnb listing ids, e.g. ["17088279", "34832567"] (the number in /rooms/<id>): your portfolio or a competitive set. One occupancy row per id and month, no search needed; name, location and rating are read from the listing page at no charge. maxListingsPerQuery does not apply. Default empty.

months.title: Months
months.description: Calendar months to read per listing, 1 to 12, starting with the current month, e.g. 6 (default 3). One row per listing and month, so the bill is delivered listings × months × $0.003. The current month counts only the days from today; the calendar covers 12 months ahead, so 12 is the maximum.
months.sectionCaption: Calendar months, rate sample and filter
months.sectionDescription: Occupancy comes from the listing's public availability calendar. The calendar does not say whether a night is booked or blocked by the host, so occupancy is a proxy; the nightly rate is sampled from the first bookable stay of each month.

maxListingsPerQuery.title: Max listings per place
maxListingsPerQuery.description: Listings per place or search URL, 1 to 280, e.g. 100 (default 40). The main cost control for a market run: at most maxListingsPerQuery × months rows per place. Airbnb caps one search at about 280; split a big city into neighbourhoods for more. Ignored for listingIds.

includeRates.title: Sample a nightly rate per month
includeRates.description: true (DEFAULT) prices the first bookable stay found per month: an available check-in, minimum nights capped at 7, for adults guests. rate_nightly is the quoted total divided by nights, not monthly or realized ADR. Sampled dates are included. One extra request, no extra charge. false leaves rate fields null and rate_status "skipped". No bookable stay: "no_stay"; calendar counts remain.

adults.title: Adults (for the rate sample)
adults.description: Guests the sampled stay is priced for, 1 to 16, e.g. 2 (default 2). Airbnb prices depend on the guest count; a listing that cannot sleep the party answers rate_status "unavailable" and its occupancy row is still delivered.

minOccupancyPct.title: Min occupancy % (filter)
minOccupancyPct.description: 0 (default) delivers every month. N keeps months with at least N% unavailable nights, e.g. 80. Unavailable combines host-blocked and guest-booked nights; it is not verified booked occupancy. Months below N are dropped before billing and rate sampling, and counted in filtered. No matching delivered rows means no row charge.

includeListingRow.title: Listing rows
includeListingRow.description: true = also emit one free listing row per listing (name, room type, location, rating, reviews count, bedrooms) for sheets that want one line per property. Default false. Never charged.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the sampled rates, e.g. "EUR" (default "USD"). Echoed on every occupancy row. When the user names no currency, pass the destination's ("EUR" for Lisbon).

locale.title: Language
locale.description: Airbnb locale for listing names, e.g. "en" (default), "fr", "de", "es", "pt", "ja". Occupancy and rates are not affected.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Airbnb accepts datacenter proxies for these calls: keep the default {"useApifyProxy": true}.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Leave these alone unless a run is being throttled.

sessions.title: Parallel proxy sessions
sessions.description: Parallel proxy sessions (egress IPs), 1 to 16, e.g. 4 (default 4). Each is paced at perIp requests per second; more sessions = a faster run at the same cost.

perIp.title: Requests per second per IP
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1 to 3, e.g. 1 (default 1). Airbnb tolerated 1 per second in tests; raise it only when a run is slow and not being throttled.

description: Airbnb Occupancy Rate Scraper: unavailable nights combine blocked and booked dates; actual bookings cannot be identified. Minimal input: {"locationQueries":["Lisbon, Portugal"],"months":3}. One target field is required. Delivered listing-month rows cost $0.003 each. includeRates defaults true: one sampled stay quote per month, not monthly ADR; no extra charge.
